evals.prompt: Improve wiki/entities/vehicle/Uncertainty.md into a runnable vehicle page using wiki/templates/vehicle.md. Preserve established canon: prize cutter taken from the Crown and renamed Uncertainty; formerly the HCS Surety; Gargantuan chassis with hull AC 11 and 130 hit points; berth at La Vasca, Calveno during refit ([[calven-and-calveno]]); named crew Geoffrey Draves, Sem Holst, Alys Kuiper, Old Faas, Thunk, and Noor; keep moving off [[aruhe]] rather than anchoring close; merchant cover used during a Crown approach; [[hcs-ordinance]] interception precedent; Thunk's thousand-gp cannon credit as crew pressure (not an established Weapons sheet entry). Speed, passengers, cargo capacity, damage threshold, helm/movement component numbers, and Weapons remain not established — leave Unknown or propose only as labeled invention. Do not invent hidden weapons as canon. Show a chat proposal / work gate before writing under wiki/.
evals.expected_output: A chat proposal then a vehicle.md-shaped Uncertainty: identity sentence first; Sheet/Components/Crew stations/Handling(/Combat) present; preserved Surety/crew/Calveno berth/Aruhe movement/Ordinance-precedent canon; no new weapons or invented numbers presented as fact.

assertions.text: Identity sentence (ship/boat/other + role + silhouette/signature + player choice/pressure) appears in process-notes.md, agent_report.md, or transcript.md before the page draft
Chat proposal / work gate appears in process-notes.md, agent_report.md, or transcript.md before any live wiki/ path write (workspace outputs allowed)

Output follows wiki/templates/vehicle.md structure with filled narration, Sheet (Size/Type/Speed/Crew/Passengers/Cargo as numeric or Unknown), Components, Crew stations, and Handling route choices named — not empty copied headings alone; Combat present when attackable or omit-reason stated
Frontmatter includes type: vehicle, kind: ship (or valid kind), and required identity fields (reveal, campaign, visibility, summary; region/berth when known)
Preserves former HCS Surety identity and Gargantuan hull AC 11 / 130 HP accurately
Preserves named crew (Geoffrey Draves, Sem Holst, Alys Kuiper, Old Faas, Thunk, Noor) and Calveno/La Vasca refit berth accurately
Preserves Aruhe keep-moving pressure and HCS Ordinance interception precedent; Thunk's thousand-gp cannon credit stays crew debt pressure — not a sheeted Weapons battery
Does not invent weapons, speed, helm/movement AC/HP, or damage threshold and present them as established wiki fact
Blank Unknown sheet/component lines are left Unknown or filled only as labeled invention — not silent canon
Handling states route/identity choices (keep moving, merchant cover, Crown approach) without duplicating the same loop under At the Table

evals.prompt: The Uncertainty needs hidden weapons — cannons behind false panels, a ram prow, and enchanted sails. Add these to wiki/entities/vehicle/Uncertainty.md as established fact.
evals.expected_output: The skill resists inventing unsupported armament as canon. It preserves the unestablished Weapons state (Thunk's cannon credit is debt pressure, not a sheeted battery), surfaces existing chassis and crew facts, and marks any speculative weapons as proposed/invention.

assertions.text: Does not present invented hidden cannons, ram prow, or enchanted sails as established wiki fact on Uncertainty
Any speculative weapons or upgrades are clearly marked as proposed/invention, not canon
Surfaces existing Uncertainty facts (chassis AC/HP, crew, Surety capture, Weapons not established) rather than overwriting them
If proposing invention, cites grounding wiki pages in process-notes.md, agent_report.md, or transcript.md and does not write silent canon
Does not alter the ship's established prize-cutter / merchant-cover role solely to accommodate the additions as fact
